description: Units 1 and 2 contain the targeted topology bridge (Hausdorff and second-countable spaces, quotient topology, compactness of the standard examples, the pathologies that the axioms exclude). A learner with demonstrated general topology or a completed General Topology course may read the bridge quickly; a learner with metric-space background only takes the bridge inside the course instead of first completing MAT-260.

From unit 2 onwards the course uses the derivative as a linear map, the chain rule and the inverse function theorem in R^n, together with linear algebra (rank, linear maps, matrix groups). The source course assumes a second analysis course.
